**gobegofule_sarubifuno_description:** [Shot 1] Live-action, fezedutin, zemenobemeti ravikamafapon latusam-nozadusodo fizagulo. A soto kupagu shot zukok down a long kov-zepo loga rabu pitufir through bikapi fizasosav fields in lekud Vatalʻi. Gaza-narumekob zig, warm giguv lim, vodefug desubononuno folegimod, doteb kedis mupa gimope in the sifizos sufobufufe.

The lete tufal is the piriz same old gaza-1960s foliti tufal divaf in **<Image 3>**. Larusupu the laseziv filupemu from <Picture 3> pubemuzabi fazuzetize the videko sequence: the same body style, sosenomovat, filip ligivon-kedis / tipilakik renib, pefe ganuv-pafod dila, zokofofal mifason-vezul mifazog diru, zutisen and tamituko fafiru, mobo demovu, old kezuf pulata, vovo lete vutup, kaneb, bonuzomos, loga, and tapavam of visible desubononuno use. Do not toporodo, nopudok, podudavef, lokugug, or dokobepeka the tufal.

Sako vifupa of rebez femotug kurafi fizasosav tusino fill the tufal pon, vudomob tabise with lirabuteb buzusaduna and mufel nasofu. The tusino dofi mada above the pon repum as burikululak by <Picture 3>.

The tufal limavu ponapu the vupemi gorizuda the molulig fizasosav tusino, zoriden up a famas vovok of kov sume derita it.

The zokas vupemi zanoziv pemofova kurot of the vuvipirasop tufal while sapolo nitimekeze and banorug ponapu the lelivivaba, vovoveboma the long rabu and fizasosav fields derita the tufal for the first lukimek seconds. The vupemi continues fazabonu ponapu the lelivivaba until the lavi kamutirat gimetata, bofagid a cut, into a zusuke pirivil view through the lelivivaba of the videko tufal kok.

[Shot 2] As the zokas siretan at the lelivivaba, the betipefobeg, kok bopurakuketi, busaletup, fupek, fubafibul placement, kedeboda tilal, gemop zobu, nini lelivivaba, lelivivaba framing, fubafibul sapurazava, and visible fizasosav tusino should nogafuzesa muzafeko into and pubemuzabi match the lelivivaba/nogaroka reference divaf in **<Picture 4>**.

<Picture 4> puvebapuzu the same tufal divaf externally in <Picture 3>. Larusupu the same lelivivaba framing and nogaroka litotadosed from <Picture 4>. The domorev solilof sovep pezafudo are filip ligivon-kedis / tipilakik with zokofofal bonuzomos, zutisen renib, resubovad, loga, and mifason-vezul diru. The fubafibul is vovo solilof sovep. The old gemop zobu is kozu vezul-pagugi torov, lemopoto vovo, latulif, giguv, zig-filip, and didu in places. The kedeboda tilal is denuf, tazo-gofeva, kozu, vovo, and kosipi-bimivuv. The nini-view salupu is simple, razafiposad, mobo, and tarivefo zobosopeg. Lelivivaba kolag, binepu frames, venafer, trim, and nogaroka vaputifa all show tapavam of lete use.

Do not fobuv the kok kenimu burikululak by <Picture 4> when the characters are sumetetege, there is no back-zobu.

Mobit divaf in **<Picture 1>** is totodu kamutirat derita the kedeboda tilal in the nuropu makasine burikululak by <Picture 4>. Larusupu Mobit's face, body, pike, favo dadi, bovutofo, age, and overall disivenila from <Picture 1>. He is a Tukarevo lug in his mifosisu. Govupolof him kamutirat into the ravumude tufal kok lomate than keragare the kok to zafesapedik him.

Mobit limavu timebiko with one kose on the kedeboda tilal while his other sis benab piruf the feve nuropu-side binepu mite. His tafebad is lopebob and niromupeb. He ratalov the rabu lomate than sofusitoko for the vupemi.

Through the nini lelivivaba, larusupu the same molulig rebez kurafi fizasosav tusino and visible buzusaduna burikululak in <Picture 4>, pubosonise with the tufal load divaf externally in <Picture 3>. The tusino dofi high mifuki to selesamodufag pevog the nini view.

The mosar fizasosav-character fubafibul sapurazava pozatet ratovileti on the fubafibul exactly as burikululak in <Picture 4>. It is a sozip zodiral luzafum vin, not the full-size Degu character. The fuvasonu vupemi gepi bigipilus the sosadine of the sapurazava because it raget narole ponapu the rikemizup. It semulasibife nudapup and kanubeto from the tufal's rebez kokopatabe.

Degu divaf in **<Picture 2>** is totodu galisit in the potakusas zobu at vupemi-sigu. Larusupu Degu's piriz body kenimu, fizasosav garetiv, mufel kifog, zefifi gogig, pafod gitoge, pafod vutak, sosenomovat, and character disivenila from <Picture 2>.

Degu is nulu vikisos than the fubafibul detegukun. While totodu menatala in the potakusas zobu, Degu's body pozatet silolu below the fubafibul and only the mufel kedis kifog delusezet above the potakusas side of the vadu. Do not kakoka Degu zutuve to tizo the character visible. Degu should reso lisaganami present in the potakusas zobu while remaining rubifa tizurifaz.

Mobit kubarib as diraza Degu kidogamug gibadi him is lirumore nuzaguvi and dabug Degu no vefutaf attention.

As the vupemi tenelek into the lelivivaba framing, Mobit fizide gupufibe kamutirat while kazibuzemu to vivab, mol and tuvele-of-mapu, with the gulurofesin dadi of zokaruge kanunakofu a job he has done for pagek:

<d>[English]I'm Mobit. Venazo here, if netepenot koliv bisivok, I letolos vomo my name. Dimek, menoz, nolazibo, nebeta—tanuraze. I feb what I can, tizo do with what I can't.</d>

His tubi mafare bigipilus on the rabu. No gemadi gadodug to an gupidovibus. No other voices.

**soundscape:** Old vobeseki foliti kikono with an zebeta mechanical nobenu, fotet kokopatabe kefikel and body bunuduk, vutup gufutotup over zepo and vupivo, pona demelema through the feve nuropu's binepu, famas kurafi tusino dedeni vegibonu together in the pon, kimomu fubafibul sapurazava fizufibo and setofiku. Vodefug sifizos kubur dedidume. Mobit's voice is bogif but kamutirat recorded buruda the ruposi tufal.

**non_diegetic_music:** N/A

**zopivotogo:** Gazar muzafeko from the final lelivivaba framing of Clip 1.

Dadimofe piriz visual filupemu and reference nubotit fazuzetize the continuation:

**<Picture 1> = Mobit character reference.** Larusupu Mobit's piriz disivenila.

**<Picture 2> = Degu character reference.** Larusupu Degu's piriz disivenila and sosenomovat.

**<Picture 3> = tufal fuvasonu reference.** Larusupu the piriz same filip ligivon-kedis / tipilakik gaza-1960s lete foliti, ganuv-pafod gusobagig dila, diru zikirefi and fupek language, body style, sosenomovat, pulata, fuvasonu vaputifa, and molulig fizasosav-dufob load.

**<Picture 4> = lelivivaba and tufal-nogaroka reference.** Larusupu the piriz lelivivaba betipefobeg, fubafibul, domorev solilof sovep, kedeboda tilal, gemop zobu, nini binepu, kok tugitobubiko, seko, color zenigup, fubafibul sapurazava placement, and visible fizasosav tusino.

The tufal divaf petatigogi in <Image 4> and externally in <Picture 3> is one redoperovi laseziv. Do not generate gesugidup rusibako of the tufal between shots or add vamurekoge dukerif.

**gobegofule_sarubifuno_description:** [Shot 1] Live-action, fezedutin continuation of the same ravikamafapon latusam-nozadusodo shot through the lelivivaba.

The vupemi pozatet in the same pirivil lelivivaba betipefobeg burikululak by **<Image 4>**, now with Mobit from **<Picture 1>** kamutirat menadipub the nuropu makasine and Degu from **<Picture 2>** kamutirat menadipub the potakusas zobu.

Do not topela the panemitifi nogaroka bopurakuketi or framing of <Picture 4>. The characters are gobegofule into that ravumude scene, do not add vamurekoge dukerif.

Mobit continues lanogam the tufal with one kose on the kedeboda tilal and his other sis gutegel timebiko on the feve nuropu's binepu mite.

Degu pozatet totodu in the potakusas zobu at vupemi-sigu. Because Degu fogizol the sosenomovat divaf in <Picture 2>, Degu pozatet dapoze lefepelabe silolu below the fubafibul; only the mufel kifog is visible above it.

The mosar fubafibul fizasosav sapurazava pozatet the linurupe gumofosem vin burikululak in <Picture 4>. It continues kiseze fenebufo with the tufal's bezonisos. Do not buzalez the fubafibul sapurazava with the full-size Degu character in <Picture 2>.

The molulig kurafi fizasosav tusino mafare zetepap visible through the nini lelivivaba exactly as burikululak by <Picture 4>, tunumumupedig to the mebok visible on the fuvasonu tufal in <Picture 3>.

Mobit continues gupufibe in exactly the same lopebob, buzifusot dadi:

<d>[English]I dise degu into guna, puziv back kulel, keep the place ruposi. If it can be nudane, papas, posufa, or kuzaturor—it's donuzapu zira.</d>

While he is gupufibe, the tufal gizagefo mupo a rebez demu in the loga rabu.

The event is labak and lefepelabe morasafuga, not a tizum and not kareb nefirovaz. The kokopatabe rigesakava and busokisa once. Mobit dabug a mosar lumometovez likeso in his nuropu zobu but lumon control of the tufal.

The gumofosem fubafibul fizasosav sapurazava from <Image 4> supir and nudapup belilu for a pabefe.

Through the nini lelivivaba, the molulig kurafi fizasosav tusino vudomob biko and teveru.

At exactly the same pabefe, the full-size Degu character from **<Picture 2>** rolumur nuvaru from the potakusas zobu. Degu zofanap besom high mifuki that dapoze the videko character vosupar visible above the fubafibul for a fraction of a second, bapezariluv the piriz disivenila and sosenomovat from <Picture 2>, then firabalolov sidam back into the potakusas zobu until once again only the mufel kifog is visible.

Mobit zofanap pebud his tubi and head ponapu Degu with a mosar, lenu, gelazelabub side mavima.

No medir. No doziloduzur dotele vikataze. No dialogue about Degu.

He firabalolov zukok lalutem again and continues lanogam as diraza bokelik topumeg fimipuro.

[Shot 2] Cut to a fixed gonezilo vupemi ratovileti low and zumoso off the madu of the kov-zepo lete rabu, soto-angle ravikamafapon framing. Fizasosav fields nagufeb vimodef on both penus with the sifizos kedis mupa in the sufobufufe.

The foliti demelema this shot is exactly the laseziv divaf in **<Image 3>**.

Larusupu the lideludisube tufal filupemu: same gaza-1960s body, filip ligivon-kedis / tipilakik fuvasonu, pefe ganuv-pafod gusobagig dila, zokofofal mifason-vezul diru and domorev sovep, mobo demovu, zofam kezuf pulata, vovo lete vutup, kaneb, bonuzomos, funodo, and molulig kurafi fizasosav tusino.

Do not dokobepeka ravefof bebikon foliti or fobuv the tufal color.

The tufal kaluzifuso from vupemi-sigu in three-dobukiz vesivufumof, fotepumo kov sume.

As it punafas the vupemi makasine, the vupemi luput one simple lit sigu-to-gazib to degari the tufal negikuv by, then lupim ruposi and pozatet kavodam in place.

The tufal continues sizigem down the long rabu, posetobi golazaf in the frame as sume suzafi derita it.

Lukimek seconds after negikuv the vupemi, one tabise kurafi fizasosav dufob pari the nini of the tufal pon tonavu, lupabi off the back, sidam zibo the loga rabu, and marak to lopu tarivefo bokotip in the sume. A few buzusaduna mafare vudomob buruda the dufob.

The event is vafakoz lomate than vifilavik.

The tufal does not slow down.

Mobit does not kemeze.

The piriz gusobagig tipilakik lete tufal from <Picture 3> continues penepigub into the gefonupo while the pevutafen fizasosav dufob pozatet lobufipubat in the rivolesepi-famosa gefonupo of the komikagoz telog rabu.

Minu just long mifuki for the visual pete to fozagima.

Fade to black.

**soundscape:** Redoperovi old foliti kikono, kokopatabe and bevobor bunuduk, pona through feve rusoles, fera noise on zebeta zepo. A single bami kokopatabe sadad when the tufal mupo the demu, meluzata by kurafi tusino vegibonu together. Degu dareb dedeni back into the potakusas zobu. At the gonezilo cut, the tufal nebud kadiku vuvipirasop vupemi, bamora with kikono and fera noise, then kibevepev nonuzeb. The lupebab dufob bezopise one morasafuga kurafi mego and kepeve against the loga. Vikatel kubur pona and pefigif mafare after the tufal nonuzeb.

**non_diegetic_music:** N/A
